sentences.text: O R D E R

The petitioner is an accused in a case bearing Crime No.39/2022 registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior Madhya Pradesh for the offences punishable under Sections 420 & 409 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: His 2nd bail application was dismissed by the High Court.
Being aggrieved

,
he approached this Court.
He has already undergone about 1 year and 1 month in jail.
Heard learned senior counsel/counsel for the petitioner and the respondent-State.

Considering the period of incarceration of the petitioner and also the fact that the charge sheet has already been filed as we have been informed at the Bar, we are of the opinion that a case of bail is made out for the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
